title: AI Community of Practice weekly gathering

---

Join the AI Community of Practice for its weekly gathering on Dec. 31, 2025, at 10 a.m. PST via Zoom. This event is an opportunity for members to connect, share insights, and discuss the latest developments in artificial intelligence. Attendees can expect engaging discussions, collaborative problem-solving, and networking with fellow AI enthusiasts. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your journey in AI, this gathering offers valuable resources and support for everyone. Don't miss the chance to expand your knowledge and meet like-minded individuals in the AI community.
